title: Startup readiness falsely returns HTTP 200
evidence: TDF.App.Boot bootApp uses status200; live /health returned 200 with status/db starting.
userImpact: Load balancer may route people to an app that cannot serve their tasks.
rootCause: Health status represents listening rather than readiness.
proposedChange: Serve 503 with Retry-After until initialization atomically swaps in mkApp.
acceptanceCriteria: Startup /health and protected paths return 503; initialized health still returns 200/ok; no schema or gate changes.
verificationMethod: Two executable Hspec tests; full CI/build and staging still required.

title: Browser storage denial can prevent public app startup
surface: Browser storage denial can prevent public app startup
evidence: i18n/index.ts reads localStorage before module initialization; AppThemeProvider read/write outside try; SessionContext evaluates storage getter before its inner catch. Runtime regression added before fixes. Follow-up provider integration reproduced two further crashes with actual nonempty locale/currency catalog data. Original browser fixture had empty catalog data and missed this path.
userImpact: Visitor cannot reach login or discovery when browser storage is restricted.
rootCause: Optional preferences/session cache treated as required boot dependencies.
proposedChange: Keep preferences in memory when storage unavailable; protect getter/read/write boundaries without fabricating a session.
acceptanceCriteria: Anonymous login renders and theme toggle retains input under denied operations/getters; no uncaught errors; no unauthorized session created.
verificationMethod: Playwright Chromium/Firefox/WebKit, desktop/tablet/phone and axe; exact baseline/final logs.
releaseStatus: Local storage follow-up fixed; provider integration 4/4 and realistic catalog browser cases 10/10 across five profiles. New exact-head CI still required.

title: FanHub hides guidance before persisted completion and accepts stale session replies
journey: authenticated onboarding, interruption and return visits
roles: customer, returning account, guest and manager tips
evidence: Source baseline 19d8dc830: optimistic dismissal before POST receipt, party-only context fence, unvalidated receipt, unguarded global dismissal storage. Reused PR #368 conformance cases against current component; see fanhub-onboarding.md.
userImpact: Users can see completion before persistence, lose retry guidance or receive previous-session state.
rootCause: Presentation state served as completion authority and party ID as session identity.
proposedChange: Validate authoritative DTO/terminal receipt, retain guidance with retry, capture credential, fence session generations and coalesce explicit close; keep guest/manager tips ephemeral.
acceptanceCriteria: FH-01 through FH-06 in fanhub-onboarding.md; no automatic completion, firstValue fabrication or stale session update; single pending command per generation; accessible retry and conditional liveness.
verificationMethod: TLC safety/conditional liveness with five negative controls; component/API conformance; 14 isolated browser cases across five profiles; actual backend/native scope remains separate.
releaseStatus: Implemented locally: 212 suites/2031 tests, typecheck/lint, 14 browser cases and formal runner pass; no merge or deployment.

title: Artist activation loses persisted success with denied storage and accepts stale same-account responses
journey: artist activation and verified existing-artist management
evidence: Two new component regressions failed on published 2813737f6: denied sessionStorage prevents editor navigation; same-account credential rotation accepts an old session result. Original seven tests still passed.
userImpact: A created profile appears failed; old asynchronous results can overwrite the current session or confirm an old claim.
rootCause: Optional browser storage is read without a guard and session authority checks only partyId.
proposedChange: Fence operations by current session object/generation and component lifetime, preserve single-flight behavior, require confirmed Artist authority, and fall back to memory when storage is denied. Remount claim panel by opaque session generation.
acceptanceCriteria: No old-session result applies after rotation/account change/unmount; no browser storage requirement for a confirmed activation; claims remain pending verified review; no identity transfer.
verificationMethod: Two activation regressions failed before repair (7 preexisting passed); malformed claim receipt also failed before validation. Final 18/18 component tests pass. Current event formal runner passed safety/liveness/negative controls and Alloy; CurrentContext/SingleFlight/TerminalOnly map to session identity, flight guard and validated receipts. Model bounds and assumptions remain those of fanhub-onboarding.md; does not prove artist database or authorization.
verificationStatus: 18 focused tests, typecheck and lint passed; catalog classified new synthetic fixture; exact-head CI pending
